const patch = "*** Begin Patch
*** Add File: /app/output/gen.py
+"""Visual-seeking pick and place controller for the live RoboCasa episode.
+
+The controller uses RGB/depth from the robot cameras and the public proprioceptive
+end-effector/joint state.  It estimates object points by color segmentation and
+camera projection, and estimates the arm's local pose Jacobian with small joint
+motions.  No simulator state or task success signal is read.
+"""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+import json
+import time
+from pathlib import Path
+
+import numpy as np
+from scipy.ndimage import label
+from scipy.spatial.transform import Rotation
+
+from rcb_client import Robot
+
+
+OUT = Path("/app/output")
+OUT.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
+
+
+class Controller:
+    def __init__(self):
+        self.robot = Robot()
+        self.cams = list(self.robot.spec()["cameras"])
+        self.actions = []
+
+    def observe(self, cameras=None, depth=False):
+        if cameras is None:
+            cameras = self.cams
+        return self.robot.get_obs(cameras=cameras, include_depth=depth, video="none")
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def state(obs):
+        n = np.asarray(obs.meta["proprio"]["now"], dtype=float)
+        q = n[4:11].copy()
+        p = n[26:29].copy()
+        R = np.asarray(obs.meta["cameras"]["robot0_eye_in_hand"]["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)[:3, :3]
+        return q, p, R
+
+    def send(self, q, steps=5, grip=-1.0, base=(0.0, 0.0, 0.0), torso=0.0):
+        a = np.zeros(13, dtype=float)
+        a[:7] = np.asarray(q, dtype=float)
+        a[7] = float(grip)
+        a[8:11] = np.asarray(base, dtype=float)
+        a[11] = float(torso)
+        a[12] = -1.0  # arm mode
+        rows = np.tile(a, (int(steps), 1))
+        result = self.robot.submit("joint_position", rows, interpolate="hold",
+                                   cameras=["robot0_eye_in_hand"], video="none")
+        self.actions.append({"q": a[:7].tolist(), "grip": float(grip),
+                             "base": list(map(float, base)), "torso": float(torso),
+                             "steps": int(steps)})
+        if result.done:
+            raise RuntimeError(f"episode ended: {result.meta.get('reason')}")
+        return self.observe(["robot0_eye_in_hand"])
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def point_from_pixel(obs, camera, u, v, depth=None):
+        cam = obs.meta["cameras"][camera]
+        K = np.asarray(cam["intrinsic_cv"], dtype=float)
+        T = np.asarray(cam["cam2world_gl"], dtype=float)
+        if depth is None:
+            depth = float(obs.depth[camera][0, int(v), int(u)])
+        x = (float(u) - K[0, 2]) * depth / K[0, 0]
+        y_up = -(float(v) - K[1, 2]) * depth / K[1, 1]
+        return (T @ np.array([x, y_up, -depth, 1.0]))[:3]
+
+    @staticmethod
+    def largest_component(mask, min_area=8):
+        labels, n = label(mask)
+        best = None
+        for k in range(1, n + 1):
+            ys, xs = np.where(labels == k)
+            if len(xs) >= min_area and (best is None or len(xs) > len(best[0])):
+                best = (xs, ys)
+        if best is None:
+            raise RuntimeError("target color component not visible")
+        return best
+
+    def detect_egg(self, obs):
+        camera = "robot0_eye_in_hand"
+        im = obs.last[camera]
+        m = ((im[:, :, 0] > 140) & (im[:, :, 1] > 60) & (im[:, :, 1] < 190) &
+             (im[:, :, 2] < 110) & (im[:, :, 0] > 1.2 * im[:, :, 1]))
+        xs, ys = self.largest_component(m, min_area=25)
+        u, v = int(np.median(xs)), int(np.median(ys))
+        d = float(np.median(obs.depth[camera][0, ys, xs]))
+        return self.point_from_pixel(obs, camera, u, v, d), (u, v), d
+
+    def detect_plate(self, obs):
+        # The agent view is calibrated in world coordinates and sees the counter
+        # plate from above; color separates the tan plate from the pale counter.
+        camera = "robot0_agentview_left"
+        im = obs.last[camera]
+        m = ((im[:, :, 0] > 150) & (im[:, :, 1] > 90) & (im[:, :, 2] > 45) &
+             (im[:, :, 0] > im[:, :, 1] + 18) &
+             (im[:, :, 1] > im[:, :, 2] + 18) & (im[:, :, 2] < 180))
+        xs, ys = self.largest_component(m, min_area=80)
+        u, v = int(np.median(xs)), int(np.median(ys))
+        d = float(np.median(obs.depth[camera][0, ys, xs]))
+        return self.point_from_pixel(obs, camera, u, v, d), (u, v), d
+
+    def pose_jacobian(self, eps=0.06, probe_steps=5):
+        """Finite-difference [linear, angular] camera/tool pose vs arm joints."""
+        o0 = self.observe(["robot0_eye_in_hand"])
+        q0, p0, R0 = self.state(o0)
+        J = np.zeros((6, 7), dtype=float)
+        for j in range(7):
+            qt = q0.copy()
+            qt[j] += eps
+            o1 = self.send(qt, steps=probe_steps)
+            q1, p1, R1 = self.state(o1)
+            dq = q1[j] - q0[j]
+            if abs(dq) < 1e-4:
+                raise RuntimeError(f"joint {j + 1} did not respond to probe")
+            J[:3, j] = (p1 - p0) / dq
+            J[3:, j] = Rotation.from_matrix(R1 @ R0.T).as_rotvec() / dq
+            self.send(q0, steps=probe_steps + 1)
+        return J
+
+    def move_pose(self, target_p, target_R=None, max_iters=30,
+                  pos_tol=0.018, rot_tol=0.10, max_pos_step=0.055):
+        """Move by receding-horizon differential IK while holding camera/tool pose."""
+        target_p = np.asarray(target_p, dtype=float)
+        if target_R is None:
+            target_R = self.state(self.observe(["robot0_eye_in_hand"]))[2]
+        target_R = np.asarray(target_R, dtype=float)
+        for it in range(max_iters):
+            o = self.observe(["robot0_eye_in_hand"])
+            q, p, R = self.state(o)
+            dp = target_p - p
+            dr = Rotation.from_matrix(target_R @ R.T).as_rotvec()
+            if np.linalg.norm(dp) <= pos_tol and np.linalg.norm(dr) <= rot_tol:
+                return {"position": p, "rotation_error": dr, "iterations": it}
+            n_dp = np.linalg.norm(dp)
+            if n_dp > max_pos_step:
+                dp *= max_pos_step / n_dp
+            n_dr = np.linalg.norm(dr)
+            if n_dr > 0.12:
+                dr *= 0.12 / n_dr
+
+            J = self.pose_jacobian()
+            # Scale orientation into roughly 20 cm/radian before damped least squares.
+            W = np.diag([1.0, 1.0, 1.0, 0.20, 0.20, 0.20])
+            e = W @ np.r_[dp, dr]
+            A = W @ J
+            dq = A.T @ np.linalg.solve(A @ A.T + (0.035 ** 2) * np.eye(6), e)
+            peak = np.max(np.abs(dq))
+            if peak > 0.16:
